runtime_check.stimulus: Explicit DC current source equal to the sourced rated current (critical fact i_rated) driven from net 'return' into net 'board'; board = terminal P1 (first numbered contact); its mating terminal M1 and every other terminal on 'return' (other contact resistors then sit return-to-return and carry no current); isolated roles on their own single-pin nets.
runtime_check.comparison: interval: 0 <= R_path <= rc (sourced contact_resistance max). Secondary absolute check: drop = i_rated*rc with the locked bench's relative tolerance 0.1% (BEH-CON-FFC/B1 (equation form) - no SDSOCKET bench is a contact drop), evaluated at the bound part's sourced values instead of the bench example values. Expected drop 0.5 A*0.1 ohm = 50 mV. SDSOCKET/B1 is the card-detect divider and B2 a supply sag; neither locks an I*Rc contact drop, so the interval check against the sourced max is primary and the absolute form borrows the FFC/B1 I*R equation.
runtime_check.derived_from: BEH-CON-FFC/B1 (equation form) - no SDSOCKET bench is a contact drop (locked I*Rc contact-drop equation and 0.1% tolerance) + sourced fields rc and i_rated
runtime_check.new_probe_needed_for_class: Yes. runtime_benches.dc_probe_definition has no BEH-CON-* branch. Proposed shared 'connector contact path' branch for BEH-CON-USB/HDMI/MODJACK/AUDIO/DCJACK/SDSOCKET(/FFC): roles {P1:'board', others:'return', required_isolated roles on their own nets}, DCExcitation(positive_net='return', negative_net='board', value=i_rated A), new observable 'contact_path_resistance' = v(board)/current in _dc_observation (same shape as the inductor 'dc_resistance' observable). Limits text: isothermal single-contact DC resistance against the sourced maximum; does not validate heating, simultaneous-contact derating, signal integrity, protocol or safe mating.
